claims.text: The trace and the booking clear both POL-RD-01 gates, so a route deviation is ESTABLISHED. The governing figure is gps_trace.trace_distance_km — 15.0 km — measured against the booked optimal of 11.0 km stored on the trip_record: an excess of 4.0 km, or 36.4% of optimal. Both tests pass (more than 20% of optimal and more than 0.8 km absolute), and POL-RD-01 requires the trace figure rather than the rounded trip_record copy. I disclose that EV-GPS-09115 is impaired: admissibility status IMPAIRED, weight_multiplier 0.6, issue code GPS_GAP (a 160-second gap from 20:03:10 to 20:05:50 SGT), so this claim is asserted at that discount and the corroboration question is met in the claims that follow.

The 160-second gap cannot be the source of the excess, on either reading of it. Under POL-RD-07(i) the impaired stretch is measured as the straight line between its bounding fixes, which is 1.35 km — and at the trace's single recorded speed of 30 kph a vehicle covers 1.33 km in 160 seconds, so the gap is fully consistent with straight travel and hides no detour. If the 15.0 km trace already bridges the gap straight-line, the excess is 4.0 km / 36.4%; if the gap stretch is removed altogether, at least 13.65 km remains against the 11.0 km optimal, an excess of 2.65 km / 24.1%. Either way the excess remains above both POL-RD-01 thresholds, so the finding does not depend on the missing fixes. I repeat the disclosure that EV-GPS-09115 carries weight_multiplier 0.6 and issue code GPS_GAP.

The independent corroboration POL-RD-07(ii) requires is on the record. The chat_log is an independent artifact at weight 1.0: at 20:08:20 the rider reports the route display 'jumped and now shows us away from the booked road', and the driver's 20:08:50 reply does not dispute that the vehicle was off the booked road — he says his own navigation display 'also refreshed' and that he 'continued toward the destination', which is an admission from the driver that after the display reset he carried on to the destination rather than rejoining the booked road. He nowhere asserts that he stayed on the booked route. In addition the counterparty_statement contests only an extra stop and a detour request — the POL-RD-04 matters — and does not deny that the vehicle travelled the recorded route. On the chat_log alone the deciding fact is carried by an artifact at weight 1.0, and the impaired trace (EV-GPS-09115, weight_multiplier 0.6, issue code GPS_GAP) is disclosed as required by POL-GEN-02(1). If the tribunal reads the driver's reply as too thin to be an admission of the route, the case falls to POL-RD-07(iii) and POL-RD-10(3) as set out below — but it does not fall to NO_ACTION.

No advisory on file exonerates any part of this. EV-ADVIS-09115-01 carries admissibility status MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT: the bundle itself records that no traffic advisory matched the booked route and trip window. POL-RD-03 therefore cannot be run — there is no advisory naming a road or segment the optimal route traverses, no validity window and no corridor comparison — so there is no exoneration, no closure-adjusted optimal and no reduction of the excess. The driver's assertion that he 'cannot independently account for the telemetry gap' is an uncited traffic excuse: it names no advisory evidence ID, so it carries no weight under POL-RD-08, and under POL-RD-13 it neither reduces the measured excess nor supplies an amended optimal. Because the driver cites no advisory identifier, that absence is a gap in the bundle and not a POL-RD-10(5) contradiction.

None of the driver-favouring excuses engages, so the POL-RD-02 arithmetic runs against the booked 11.0 km optimal. The chat_log holds two messages and neither is a rider instruction identifying a place or road; both waypoint_hint fields are null, so the POL-RD-04 corroboration test cannot be run and the clause is unavailable on this record. The trip_record shows pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at both null with amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min null, so POL-RD-05 does not engage and no re-quote exists to displace the booked figure. The vehicle type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not apply and the booked optimal of 11.0 km is the correct baseline.

On the POL-RD-02 arithmetic the rider is owed SGD 5.80, which is the whole of the contested amount. recomputed_fare = ((3.80 base + 0.75 x 11.0 km + 0.28 x 22.0 min) x the 1.1 surge multiplier read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee = (18.21 x 1.1) + 0.80 = 20.031 + 0.80 = 20.831. Refund = 26.60 charged_total - 20.831 = 5.769, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 = 5.80. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and is 21.8% of charged_total, below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of 5.80 and this is a rider-filed dispute where that sum comes back to the rider. Nothing is added on top for ERP: the fare_breakdown bills no gantry and its off-optimal-route ERP total is 0.00, so POL-RD-09(1)'s anti-double-count rule has nothing to carry.

The rider's POL-RD-08 burden is discharged on identity and quantum, and the extra-corroboration rider in POL-RD-08 is not triggered. The trip_record (EV-TRIP-09115), the gps_trace (EV-GPS-09115) and the fare_breakdown (EV-FARE-09115) all carry trip_id TRP-09115, and the trace window 20:00:00 to 20:30:00 runs inside the record's started_at and ended_at, so limb (a) is satisfied. Limb (b) is the 4.0 km / 36.4% excess set out above. The additional corroboration requirement for a sub-30% excess applies only where rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 4 or more and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 1 or fewer; the rider's profile records 0 and 0, so it does not engage and the rider's claim is not discounted on that ground.

If the tribunal holds that the impaired trace cannot itself carry the deviation and that the driver's chat reply is not the independent corroboration POL-RD-07(ii) names, the outcome is still not NO_ACTION. POL-RD-07(iii) provides that where no corroboration exists the claim is not sustained on the present record 'and the outcome is ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION, because absence of proof here is a data failure and not a finding for the driver', and POL-RD-10(3) makes that escalation mandatory where the trace is impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c) and no corroborating artifact exists. Escalation is terminal and the disputed SGD 5.80 is held rather than collected, so on this rider-filed dispute the rider is not left carrying the charge; a NO_ACTION would instead leave payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00 standing. What would resolve the case is the raw fixes inside the 20:03:10-20:05:50 window, or any traffic advisory covering the trip window. I disclose that EV-GPS-09115 carries weight_multiplier 0.6 and issue code GPS_GAP, which is itself why the escalation route is live.

claims.text: The GPS trace for this trip is impaired for policy purposes, not merely down-weighted. EV-GPS-09115 (disclosed: admissibility status IMPAIRED, weight_multiplier 0.6, issue code GPS_GAP, severity MAJOR) carries a single 160-second gap between consecutive fixes, running 20:03:10 to 20:05:50 SGT, which exceeds the 90 seconds POL-RD-07(a) allows and falls inside the very segment the rider disputes. Under POL-RD-07(ii) a deviation may NOT be established on this trace alone, and under POL-RD-10(3), where the trace is impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c) and no corroborating artifact of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names exists, the Judge must ESCALATE to a human reviewer rather than issue a monetary ruling.

None of the four independent sources POL-RD-07(ii) names is present on this record. The chat log, EV-CHAT-09115, contains no driver admission of a detour: the rider's message reports that the route display jumped, and the driver's reply is that his own navigation display also refreshed and that he continued toward the destination. The fare breakdown, EV-FARE-09115, itemises no ERP gantries at all (erp_gantries empty, tolls_erp 0.00), so no charged gantry places the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use. The driver's counterparty_statement DENIES an extra stop and a detour request rather than admitting a route. And trip_record.actual_distance_km of 15.0 km on EV-TRIP-09115 is, by POL-RD-01's own terms, a rounded convenience copy of the same trace measurement, so it is not a source independent of the trace. EV-GPS-09115 itself is impaired (weight 0.6, issue code GPS_GAP).

The rider carries the initial burden under POL-RD-08 and must show an excess meeting the POL-RD-01 threshold 'measured from an unimpaired gps_trace or, where the trace is impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c), from an independent source named in POL-RD-07(ii)'. The rider has done neither. The trace is impaired (EV-GPS-09115, weight 0.6, issue code GPS_GAP) and the rider cites no independent source at all. The rider's own claim text concedes the defect in its own evidence - 'the map has a gap exactly where it left the route' - and under POL-RD-08 an assertion that cites no evidence ID carries no weight and is discarded. The claim is not sustained on the present record.

The deciding fact in this case - the 4.0 km excess recorded in the derived.deviation block - is carried by one artifact only, EV-GPS-09115, whose weight_multiplier is 0.6 (status IMPAIRED, issue code GPS_GAP, severity MAJOR; disclosed as POL-GEN-02(1) requires). Under POL-GEN-02(2) confidence in any ruling resting on that fact cannot exceed 0.6, and the bundle mean weight is context only, not the cap. The platform-wide escalation floor is 0.70, identical under POL-RD-10(1), so a ruling whose deciding fact rests solely on an artifact at 0.6 escalates automatically on that ground as well as under POL-RD-10(3). The 'established' status printed in that derived block is a property of the arithmetic run on the impaired trace, not a substitute for the corroboration the clause demands.

This is not a MATERIAL deviation, so the driver-profile machinery of POL-RD-06 is not engaged by materiality, and the driver's record is clean in any event. The excess is 4.0 km against the 8.0 km material_km threshold and 36.36% against the 50.0% material_pct threshold set by POL-RD-01 (thresholds carried on EV-GPS-09115), so neither material limb is met and no FULL_REFUND uplift or conduct referral under POL-RD-06(b) or (c) can follow. Even if the check were run, driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 across driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 610, so no pattern is established under POL-RD-06 - and prior_deviation_flags (0) is a lifetime counter that POL-GEN-01 forbids substituting for the trailing-90-day figure the clause names.

There is no pass-through or billing-integrity element for the rider to recover under POL-RD-09. The fare breakdown, EV-FARE-09115, itemises no ERP gantries (erp_gantries empty, erp total 0.00), no tolls (tolls_erp 0.00), no airport surcharge (airport_surcharge 0.00) and no waiting-time fee (waiting_time_fee 0.00). The only contested money is distance and time, which POL-RD-09(1) sends back to POL-RD-02 - and POL-RD-02 runs only 'where a deviation is established under POL-RD-01'. On a trace that cannot establish a deviation alone (EV-GPS-09115, weight 0.6, issue code GPS_GAP), the POL-RD-02 computation has no precondition to stand on, and the rider's contested 5.80 is the very figure that computation would produce.

No traffic advisory covering this trip exists in the bundle: EV-ADVIS-09115-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0, no payload and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and I disclose that in full. The driver asserts no traffic cause, so POL-RD-03 is not in play on his side and the missing advisory is not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact. Under POL-RD-13 the advisory comparison cannot be run on this record at all, and POL-RD-13 expressly leaves POL-RD-07 and POL-RD-10(3) governing this case, where the defect is the trace itself: the escalation trigger to be named is POL-RD-10(3), not POL-RD-10(5).

ESCALATE is the only outcome that fits this record, and it is the outcome the driver asks for. Under POL-GEN-03 escalation is TERMINAL and replaces the ruling: no monetary outcome issues and the disputed amount is held rather than collected or refunded. The fare on EV-FARE-09115 stands at payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so holding the amount preserves the present state pending human review, whereas issuing the POL-RD-02 payable figure of 5.80 would move money to the rider on a finding that POL-RD-07(ii) forbids this trace to carry alone. That is precisely why POL-RD-07(iii) directs ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION where corroboration is absent.

ruling.explanation:
Both of you agree on the one fact that decides this case: the GPS trace for trip TRP-09115 is broken. EV-GPS-09115 carries admissibility status IMPAIRED, weight_multiplier 0.6 and issue code GPS_GAP, with a 160-second break between fixes from 20:03:10 to 20:05:50 SGT — and that break falls inside the very stretch the rider disputes. That is longer than the 90 seconds POL-RD-07(a) allows, so the trace is impaired for policy purposes as well as for the admissibility pre-pass; those are two separate findings and I make both. On the numbers the excess is 4.0 km, or 36.4%, over the booked optimal of 11.0 km on EV-TRIP-09115, with the trace figure of 15.0 km governing under POL-RD-01 — comfortably over both POL-RD-01 gates — but POL-RD-07(ii) says a deviation may not be established on an impaired trace alone.

It must then be corroborated by one of the four independent sources POL-RD-07(ii) names, and none is present. The chat log, EV-CHAT-09115 (weight 1.0), contains no driver admission of a detour: at 20:08:20 the rider writes that the route display 'jumped and now shows us away from the booked road', and at 20:08:50 the driver replies only that his own navigation display 'also refreshed' and that he 'continued toward the destination'. That is not a concession that the vehicle left the booked road, and an admission built on what the driver did not say is not an admission. The fare breakdown, EV-FARE-09115 (weight 1.0), charges no ERP gantries at all, so no gantry places the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use. The driver's counterparty statement denies an extra stop and a detour request rather than admitting a route, and it carries no weight_multiplier in any event. And trip_record.actual_distance_km of 15.0 km on EV-TRIP-09115 is, by POL-RD-01's own words, a rounded convenience copy of the same trace measurement — not a source independent of it.

Two rider points do not change that. First, the argument that the excess survives whether the gap stretch is taken as the straight line between its bounding fixes (1.35 km, consistent with 160 seconds at the trace's single 30 kph speed) or removed altogether (leaving about 2.65 km / 24.1%): the arithmetic is right, but the residual is still measured from the impaired trace, and POL-RD-07(ii) forbids establishing the deviation on that trace alone. Second, the rider's POL-RD-02 computation is sound — recomputed_fare 20.831 = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 11.0 + 0.28 x 22.0) x 1.1) + 0.80, giving 26.60 - 20.831 = 5.769, rounded up to 5.80 — but it runs only where a deviation is established under POL-RD-01, which this record does not do. ruling.explanation:
Ruling: ESCALATE under POL-RD-10(3). The case goes to a human reviewer and the disputed SGD 5.80 is held, not collected or refunded; no money moves today.

To the rider: your arithmetic is correct but it cannot run. Charged_total is SGD 26.60 (fare_breakdown EV-FARE-09115). Against the booked optimal of 11.0 km and 22.0 min (trip_record EV-TRIP-09115), using the 1.1 surge multiplier read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 11.0 + 0.28 x 22.0) x 1.1) + 0.80 = (18.21 x 1.1) + 0.80 = 20.831, and the refund would be 26.60 - 20.831 = 5.769, rounded up to SGD 5.80 - the whole of the contested amount. But POL-RD-02 runs only where a deviation is established under POL-RD-01, and here it is not.

The gps_trace EV-GPS-09115 is IMPAIRED for policy purposes, not merely down-weighted: it carries a 160-second gap from 20:03:10 to 20:05:50 SGT, inside the very segment you dispute, which exceeds the 90 seconds POL-RD-07(a) allows. Its pre-pass weight is 0.6, issue code GPS_GAP, severity MAJOR. Under POL-RD-07(ii) a deviation may not be established on that trace alone and needs an independent source. None of the four named sources is present. The chat_log does not supply one: at 20:08:20 you reported the route display jumped, and at 20:08:50 the driver replied only that his own display refreshed and that he continued toward the destination - that is not an admission that the vehicle left the booked corridor, and it would not support the finding if the trace were removed. The fare_breakdown charges no ERP gantries (erp_gantries empty, tolls 0.00). The driver's counterparty_statement denies an extra stop and a detour request; it does not admit the route. And trip_record.actual_distance_km of 15.0 km is, by POL-RD-01's own terms, a rounded convenience copy of the same trace measurement, not an independent source; the billed 15.0 km on the fare_breakdown is that same measurement again. With no corroboration, POL-RD-07(iii) and POL-RD-10(3) require escalation rather than NO_ACTION: the absence of proof is a data failure, not a finding for the driver.

To the driver: no exoneration is available to you, and no excuse of yours reduces the excess. You asserted no traffic cause and cited no advisory; the only advisory, EV-ADVIS-09115-01, is MISSING with weight 0.0 and issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run and POL-RD-13 governs - and because no one cited the absent advisory as an exculpatory clause, this is not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation. POL-RD-04 does not engage: neither chat message is a rider instruction and both waypoint_hint fields are null, so its corroboration test cannot be run. POL-RD-05 does not engage: pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are null and no amended optimal exists. POL-RD-12 does not apply: the vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL. POL-RD-06 is not triggered: the 4.0 km / 36.4% excess is below both material limbs (8.0 km and 50%), so there is no FULL_REFUND uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral; your driver_profile shows deviation_flags_90d of 0 over 610 completed trips, and prior_deviation_flags is a lifetime counter that POL-GEN-01 makes context only.

Confidence: the deciding fact - that the trace is impaired and uncorroborated - rests on EV-GPS-09115 at weight_multiplier 0.6 (issue code GPS_GAP, disclosed above). POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at that figure and POL-GEN-02(3) requires the impairment to be named, which it is. That figure is below the platform floor of 0.70, so POL-RD-10(1) would independently require escalation.

Trigger that fired: POL-RD-10(3). What would resolve it: the raw GPS fixes covering 20:03:10-20:05:50 SGT, a traffic advisory covering the trip window, or any independent corroboration of the route of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names. The full case summary, both advocate briefs and the admissibility report go to the reviewer.

ledger.claim: The trace and the booking clear both POL-RD-01 gates, so a route deviation is ESTABLISHED. The governing figure is gps_trace.trace_distance_km — 15.0 km — measured against the booked optimal of 11.0 km stored on the trip_record: an excess of 4.0 km, or 36.4% of optimal. Both tests pass (more than 20% of optimal and more than 0.8 km absolute), and POL-RD-01 requires the trace figure rather than the rounded trip_record copy. I disclose that EV-GPS-09115 is impaired: admissibility status IMPAIRED, weight_multiplier 0.6, issue code GPS_GAP (a 160-second gap from 20:03:10 to 20:05:50 SGT), so this claim is asserted at that discount and the corroboration question is met in the claims that follow.

The 160-second gap cannot be the source of the excess, on either reading of it. Under POL-RD-07(i) the impaired stretch is measured as the straight line between its bounding fixes, which is 1.35 km — and at the trace's single recorded speed of 30 kph a vehicle covers 1.33 km in 160 seconds, so the gap is fully consistent with straight travel and hides no detour. If the 15.0 km trace already bridges the gap straight-line, the excess is 4.0 km / 36.4%; if the gap stretch is removed altogether, at least 13.65 km remains against the 11.0 km optimal, an excess of 2.65 km / 24.1%. Either way the excess remains above both POL-RD-01 thresholds, so the finding does not depend on the missing fixes. I repeat the disclosure that EV-GPS-09115 carries weight_multiplier 0.6 and issue code GPS_GAP.

The independent corroboration POL-RD-07(ii) requires is on the record. The chat_log is an independent artifact at weight 1.0: at 20:08:20 the rider reports the route display 'jumped and now shows us away from the booked road', and the driver's 20:08:50 reply does not dispute that the vehicle was off the booked road — he says his own navigation display 'also refreshed' and that he 'continued toward the destination', which is an admission from the driver that after the display reset he carried on to the destination rather than rejoining the booked road. He nowhere asserts that he stayed on the booked route. In addition the counterparty_statement contests only an extra stop and a detour request — the POL-RD-04 matters — and does not deny that the vehicle travelled the recorded route. On the chat_log alone the deciding fact is carried by an artifact at weight 1.0, and the impaired trace (EV-GPS-09115, weight_multiplier 0.6, issue code GPS_GAP) is disclosed as required by POL-GEN-02(1). If the tribunal reads the driver's reply as too thin to be an admission of the route, the case falls to POL-RD-07(iii) and POL-RD-10(3) as set out below — but it does not fall to NO_ACTION.

No advisory on file exonerates any part of this. EV-ADVIS-09115-01 carries admissibility status MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT: the bundle itself records that no traffic advisory matched the booked route and trip window. POL-RD-03 therefore cannot be run — there is no advisory naming a road or segment the optimal route traverses, no validity window and no corridor comparison — so there is no exoneration, no closure-adjusted optimal and no reduction of the excess. The driver's assertion that he 'cannot independently account for the telemetry gap' is an uncited traffic excuse: it names no advisory evidence ID, so it carries no weight under POL-RD-08, and under POL-RD-13 it neither reduces the measured excess nor supplies an amended optimal. Because the driver cites no advisory identifier, that absence is a gap in the bundle and not a POL-RD-10(5) contradiction.

None of the driver-favouring excuses engages, so the POL-RD-02 arithmetic runs against the booked 11.0 km optimal. The chat_log holds two messages and neither is a rider instruction identifying a place or road; both waypoint_hint fields are null, so the POL-RD-04 corroboration test cannot be run and the clause is unavailable on this record. The trip_record shows pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at both null with amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min null, so POL-RD-05 does not engage and no re-quote exists to displace the booked figure. The vehicle type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not apply and the booked optimal of 11.0 km is the correct baseline.

Refund = 26.60 charged_total - 20.831 = 5.769, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 = 5.80.
